findings.description: render_finish flushes pending sub-threshold steps via make_step and render_progress, which runs before the hidden/non-atty guard and the early exit. This can change behavior in cases where no rendering was meant to happen.
findings.rationale: Trigger: the progress bar is exited early (for example, via break or an exception) with a pending remainder in _completed_intervals. The remainder is then applied, advancing pos, and may set finished=True although the loop did not complete. When output is not a TTY, render_progress runs, but it only echoes the label once, so there is no visible effect. Repeated calls to render_finish also do nothing extra because _completed_intervals is reset. Early-exit semantics are the main concern, but it is a plausible, limited misreport rather than a certain defect.
